sources.title: Single-scan 2D DOSY NMR spectroscopy
sources.supports: Spatial encoding for single-scan 2D DOSY; sequence/sample demonstrations and limitations.

sources.title: Spatially encoded 2D and 3D diffusion-ordered NMR spectroscopy
sources.authors: L. Guduff; I. Kuprov; C. van Heijenoort; J.-N. Dumez
sources.supports: Spatial parallelisation and acceleration of 2D/3D DOSY; mixture example.

sources.title: Spatially encoded diffusion-ordered NMR spectroscopy of reaction mixtures in organic solvents
sources.supports: Reaction mixture in organic solvent; subsecond SPEN experiment with convection compensation and spectral selection.

sources.title: Single-Scan 13C Diffusion-Ordered NMR Spectroscopy of DNP-Hyperpolarised Substrates
sources.authors: L. Guduff; D. Kurzbach; C. van Heijenoort; D. Abergel; J.-N. Dumez

sources.title: Ultrafast diffusion-based unmixing of 1H NMR spectra
sources.authors: R. Mishra; A. Marchand; C. Jacquemmoz; J.-N. Dumez
sources.supports: Multivariate unmixing (DECRA) with spatially encoded data; subsecond acquisition. DECRA spacing is specifically engineered.

sources.title: Speedy Component Resolution Using Spatially Encoded Diffusion NMR Data
sources.supports: SCORE versus OUTSCORE on SPEN data. Possible single-axis implementation under appropriate spoiler/coherence selection conditions.

sources.title: Accounting for gradient non-uniformity in spatially-encoded diffusion-ordered NMR spectroscopy
sources.supports: SPEN DOSY also called UF DOSY; non-uniform gradient model and calibration improve accuracy.

sources.title: Ultrafast multidimensional Laplace NMR for a rapid and sensitive chemical analysis
sources.supports: Spatially encoded D–T2 Laplace NMR with ultrafast acquisition; conceptual precursor to local D/T2 development, not proof of local prototype.
